# forecaster.metrics.mean_absolute_scaled_error { #spotforecast2_safe.forecaster.metrics.mean_absolute_scaled_error }

```python
forecaster.metrics.mean_absolute_scaled_error(y_true, y_pred, y_train)
```

Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE).

MASE is a scale-independent error metric that measures the accuracy of
a forecast. It is the mean absolute error of the forecast divided by the
mean absolute error of a naive forecast in the training set. The naive
forecast is the one obtained by shifting the time series by one period.
If y_train is a list of numpy arrays or pandas Series, it is considered
that each element is the true value of the target variable in the training
set for each time series. In this case, the naive forecast is calculated
for each time series separately.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                                                                                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                            | Default    |
|---------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| y_true  | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`)                                       | True values of the target variable.                                                                                                                                                    | _required_ |
| y_pred  | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`)                                       | Predicted values of the target variable.                                                                                                                                               | _required_ |
| y_train | [list](`list`)\[[float](`float`)\] \| [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | True values of the target variable in the training set. If `list`, it is consider that each element is the true value of the target variable in the training set for each time series. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type             | Description   |
|--------|------------------|---------------|
|        | [float](`float`) | MASE value.   |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```{python}
import numpy as np
from spotforecast2_safe.forecaster.metrics import mean_absolute_scaled_error

y_train = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8])
y_true = np.array([9, 10, 11])
y_pred = np.array([8.8, 10.2, 10.9])
mase = mean_absolute_scaled_error(y_true, y_pred, y_train)
print(mase < 1.0)
```
